properties.name: Province of Quebec (1763)
sources: Royal Proclamation of 1763, boundary clause: River St. John (Labrador coast) - Lake St. John - south end of Lake Nipissing - St. Lawrence and Lake Champlain at 45°N - the highlands - north coast of the Baie des Chaleurs - Cape Rosier - west end of Anticosti. Vertices placed at those landmarks; the highlands segment is approximate.
